positioning_check: Short interest is 22.07m shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 0.9% of shares outstanding, 3.27 days to cover (equibles.com/stocks/jnj/shortinterest, read by the sweep on 2026-10-12), so it is not crowded. The run-up is +4.07% over 5 days and -1.16% over 20 days, and the stock is 5.5% below its 52-week high.

findings.finding: Q3 adjusted EPS carries the ~$1bn Firefly Bio IPR&D charge (~$0.46/share) plus most of the Sail Biomedicines upfront (~$0.18 FY26 dilution, 'primarily' in Q3), per J&J's own 2026-09-16 Q3 economic-factors note. Aggregator consensus is split between deal-inclusive ~$2.48-2.53 and stale pre-deal $2.90-3.04, so automated 06:45 ET headlines may print an EPS 'miss' against the stale figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: the deal-driven guide cut was released 2026-07-29 after the close and shares fell 1.6% in extended trading (Reuters via wdez.com). The Q2 adjusted EPS beat ($2.90 vs $2.86) still saw the stock fall 2.69% on 2026-07-15.
findings.why_not_priced: Institutional holders know the charge, so most of this is priced. The unpriced part is mechanical: if every feed had updated, the aggregator consensus would cluster at ~$2.50, not spread from $2.48 to $3.04. A headline-driven pre-market dip that gets corrected by the close is the most this is worth.
findings.independence: Reuters 2026-07-29 (https://wdez.com/2026/07/29/johnson-johnson-lowers-2026-profit-forecast/) gives the same $0.46/$0.18 split. The consensus spread is in AAII ($2.51), finanztrends ($2.48) and the Hudson Labs/Benzinga pages. This finding shares its primary document with the FX and tariff findings.

findings.finding: J&J's guidance assumed EUR/USD 1.15; the euro averaged 1.14 in July and 1.16 in August, with spot ~1.16 in early September (company's own note). That is a small reported-revenue tailwind which could let J&J nudge the reported sales guide ($100.8-101.4bn) up at the Q3 print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: J&J raised its sales guide at Q1 and Q2 2026: April +0.9%, July -2.69%. Small reported-guide raises have not been rewarded consistently.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side models usually mark FX, so this is mostly priced. If it were fully priced, the revenue consensus ($25.29-25.37bn) would already sit at the top of the implied guide run-rate. It sits roughly in line instead, which leaves a sliver.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 1. No independent FX series was fetched; the euro averages are the company's own figures.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-14, two weeks before quarter-end, CEO Duato said MedTech is growing 'at a similar pace' in H2 as in H1, that ICOTYDE now has full US commercial coverage with ~17,000 patients and ~7,000 writers so sales should improve quarter by quarter, and that 2027 will be 'a better year than 2026'. No pre-warning was given, so the quarter is most likely to land inside or slightly above the raised guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: J&J beat both top and bottom line in Q1 and Q2 2026; the reactions were +0.9% and -2.69%. In-line or beat quarters have produced roughly 0 to -3%.
findings.why_not_priced: This was a public conference, so it is largely priced; the +4.1% five-day run-up is consistent with it. What remains is that 'similar pace' for MedTech implies H2 growth of ~4.5-6%, not the Abiomed-led re-acceleration some previews hope for. That caps the upside on MedTech, while the pharma side (Tremfya +71% in Q2, ICOTYDE coverage) supports a small revenue beat.
findings.independence: Medtechdive 2026-07-15 (https://www.medtechdive.com/news/jj-misses-company-expectations-for-cardiovascular-in-q2/825310/) reports cardiovascular +4% in Q2 and Abiomed -2%, with management expecting a gradual H2 recovery. That is a different source pointing the same muted way on MedTech.

findings.finding: Reaction function and positioning: J&J has fallen after 5 of its last 7 prints, including -2.69% on a Q2 2026 beat-and-raise. It goes into this print +4.07% over 5 sessions, 5.5% below its 52-week high, with modest put skew (+2.27 vol points).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline moves: -2.69, +0.90, -0.09, -0.03, +6.19, -0.48, -1.94. The one large up move (Jul 2025, +6.19%) followed a substantial guide raise.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the skew already leans the same way, so this is sized below the event-implied move. If the run-up and the history were fully discounted, the skew would sit near zero after a 4% rally into a print this name usually sells. Instead downside is still being bought.
findings.independence: The sealed baseline (8-K item 2.02 dates, Yahoo bars) is a separate data source from the RTTNews article. Short interest is 0.9% with 3.27 days to cover, so there is no squeeze mechanism to offset this.

findings.finding: The $5.5bn talc resolution announced 2026-07-28 requires 95% claimant participation; the Q3 note says reserve adjustments hit GAAP only. A progress update on the call could trim the litigation overhang, but no status update was found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 settlement news came days before the deal-driven guide cut; its isolated reaction was not measured.
findings.why_not_priced: The settlement itself is priced. Only the participation status is unknown, and it has no path to adjusted EPS or guidance, so it is sized as a fraction.
findings.independence: The J&J Q3 economic-factors note (2026-09-16) restates the $5.5bn terms with the first payment of up to $3bn in 2027. It is the same fact from the company side.

findings.finding: J&J said that Q2 2026 margin improvement was 'partially supported by the anticipated reduction and recoupment of certain tariff-related costs based on the latest rulings' (IEEPA refunds). Recoupment could keep supporting Q3 gross margin, but that is already inside the raised guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: margin upside alongside a raise was met with -2.69%.
findings.why_not_priced: It lands inside what the company already guided to, so it is sized near zero. It would only matter if the size of the recoupment let J&J raise the EPS guide, and nothing quantifies that.
findings.independence: Same document as findings 1 and 2. No other source names a J&J refund amount.

outside_window.finding: The Sail Biomedicines option is expected to dilute 2027 adjusted EPS by ~$1.28 (contingent on milestones and option exercise), plus $0.08 from Firefly. 2027 EPS consensus may not fully carry it, but J&J gives its 2027 guide in January after the December enterprise business review.
Enterprise business review in early December 2026 will give detail on double-digit growth by the end of the decade (Duato, 2026-09-14).
